shared_elements: horizontal bands or registers of decoration
small repeated motif-like signs arranged in rows
justification: Both are monumental worked stone bearing shallow carved motifs organised into roughly horizontal bands, which is the only real correspondence, and even that is generic. A is a flat, weathered pale wall covered edge-to-edge with dense rows of tiny repetitive incised signs, whereas B is a free-standing dark three-dimensional block with a few large, bold, curvilinear relief emblems (discs, loops, a belt-like band) on a body-shaped form.
